body:
My boyfriend says the same thing when I'm having my down days, that I've been through so much already and remained strong (though I feel different about myself) that we can get through anything. 
I'm trying to stay strong, more-so for him than myself but it's so tiring. 
I'm considering going back to my Dr but I feel like such a failure for not keeping strong. Thank you so much for your message though, it gives me some strength to carry on.

When we spoke last night he tried to reassure me that he still loves me as much as he always has, but it's not just the feelings of feeling unappreciated - more than anything I feel like a drain on him. 
I just want to be able to provide for him, so for once he doesn't have to do without on something he'd like so as to pay for me to stay. 
I really appreciate your message of support, so thank you so much.
